title: Why You NEED a Great LinkedIn Headline ✍️
description:
If you want to show up in LinkedIn search results for the jobs you are after your LinkedIn headline is a great place to spend some time. People might not know you actually have up to 220 characters so don't JUST add your job title. Add other keywords important to your field and even some achievements to display your value. #linkedinprofile #linkedintips #jobsearch
